The '''XX-3P0''' was a model of [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] that was produced during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
XX-3P0s were manufactured in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[X2-4]], on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Uffel]]. In c. [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the rogue [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[LN-73]] modified a number of XX-3P0s inside their factory on Uffel, replacing their forearms with weapons mounts and programming them to attack any organic beings who entered the room.
